title: lounge bar.wav by Tomlija

sourceDescription: One of the fanciest and most snobby Belgrade night lounges in Belgrade. I want YOU to use and abuse this sound as much as possible. This atmosphere was recorded from the street so maybe there is some of the traffic noise left in the background. But, when you think about it, who gives a damn! Enjoy and USE! Recorded with Zoom H4n. Please rate, comment and share. In case you download some of my sounds and use them in your audiovisual artwork, the only thing I ask from you is to let me know where and how they ended up.
